source_grounded_observation: Cycle 7 showed that a generator-organ mutation to an inherited compositional representation policy creates fresh useful generator-language reachability, but the evaluator explicitly invoked the generator-language mutation constructor. Therefore proposal selection and causal credit were not native BODY decisions.
hypothesis: Given only immutable prior-cycle failure/success evidence and inherited BODY state, a native meta-mutation compiler can choose among competing generator/mutator/no-op structural proposals before fresh tasks, checkpoint the chosen descendant, and after fresh hidden outcomes assign causal credit into MutationStrategyState and ExperienceArchive without evaluator-side target-operation selection.
pre_hidden_certificate_contract: Construct a typed failure certificate only from frozen cycle-6 and cycle-7 receipts: parent fixed representation language was MORE_COMPUTE exhausted, generator-language descendant produced disjoint fresh useful representations, and current hidden cycle-8 task identities/outcomes are absent.
proposal_contract: The compiler must produce at least three structurally distinct proposals (generator-language mutation, mutator-policy mutation, abstain/no-op), score them from certificate fields, select exactly one without hidden task information, and emit its MorphologyMutation plus selection trace. The evaluator may verify but may not name the selected proposal.
full_control: Checkpoint/restore the autonomously selected proposal descendant before evaluator-owned hidden task seed creation, then evaluate on 30 fresh compositional expression tasks using the selected BODY's own reachable representation generator.
remove_control: Disable the meta-mutation compiler and use the cycle-6 fixed-family parent under the same hidden tasks; useful rate must be below FULL.
wrong_control: Feed a structurally valid but wrong-layer certificate that attributes the failure to MUTATOR_SEARCH_POLICY. The autonomous compiler must choose a non-generator proposal and hidden useful rate must be below FULL.
credit_contract: Only after hidden evaluation, causal credit may update inherited MutationStrategyState and append one ExperienceUnit. Positive credit requires FULL>REMOVE, FULL>WRONG, current_outcomes_consumed_by_proposal=false, and checkpointed proposal identity match. Remove or wrong must not receive positive credit.
restart_contract: Post-credit SelfEvolvingResearchBody checkpoint/restore must preserve selected morphology, mutation strategy score/support, experience episode and generator policy fingerprint.
